title: Stop Saying "Very Weird"! 5 Better English Words #shorts
description:
Stop saying "very weird". Use one of these words instead:
• Bizarre: a bizarre hat
• Odd: an odd noise
• Peculiar: a peculiar smell
• Creepy: a creepy old house
• Surreal: a surreal scene

Comment your own word for "very weird"!
